notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing: Rohr D-ADU Text Amendment Request
notices.agenda_text:
Posted on June 26, 2026, on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: Rohr D-ADU Text Amendment Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the City Council to consider the above listed request. The purpose of the request is to amend Chapter 9-31 of the Draper City Municipal Code to alter the standards under which an existing detached accessory structure may be converted into a Detached Accessory Dwelling Unit (D-ADU).

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers, on July 7, 2026 at 7:00 p.m.  The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Todd Draper at (801) 576-6335 or todd.draper@draperutah.gov. 

Dated this 25th Day of June, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder

notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing: Kuwahara Nursery Land Use Map Amendment, Zoning Map Amendment, and Development Agreement Requests
notices.agenda_text:
Posted on June 26, 2026, on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: Kuwahara Nursery Land Use Map Amendment, Zoning Map Amendment, and Development Agreement Requests

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the City Council to consider the above listed request. The property is located at approximately 762 W. 12300 S. The purposes of the requests are to change the Land Use Map from the Commercial Office/Service designation to the Residential High-Density designation, the Zoning Map from the CO1 (Professional Office) zone to the RM2 (Multiple-Family Residential) zone, and for approval of a Development Agreement to allow for the construction of 21 detached Single-Family Dwellings on the property. 

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council, on July 7, 2026 at 7:00 p.m.  The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Todd Draper at (801) 576-6335 or todd.draper@draperutah.gov.  

Dated this 25th Day of June, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder

notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing: City Initiated Corner Lot Text Amendment Request
notices.agenda_text:
Posted on June 26, 2026, on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: City Initiated Corner Lot Text Amendment Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the City Council to consider the above listed request. The purpose of the request is to amend the text of portions of Draper City Municipal Code (DCMC) Titles 9 and 17 to clarify the definition of corner lots and how it is applied to certain properties.

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers, on July 7, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall.
 
To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Todd Taylor at (801) 576-6510 or todd.taylor@draperutah.gov. 

Dated this 25th Day of June, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder
